items.title: Anthropic Confirms Claude Mythos 5 Redeployment for US Critical Infrastructure Organizations
items.description: Anthropic has confirmed that Claude Mythos 5, its most powerful AI cybersecurity model, will be redeployed to a select set of U.S. organizations responsible for operating and defending critical infrastructure, following a government-led review process that began on June 12, 2026. items.title: New Bucket Hijacking Attack Allows Hackers to Reroute Cloud Data Streams to External Storage
items.description: A critical cloud storage attack technique dubbed “bucket hijacking” a method that enables threat actors to silently redirect an organization’s active cloud data streams, including audit logs and telemetry, into attacker-controlled external storage buckets across major cloud platforms. items.title: New DirtyClone Linux Vulnerability Allows Attackers to Gain Root Access Via Cloned Packets
items.description: A new Linux kernel local privilege escalation vulnerability, dubbed “DirtyClone” (CVE-2026-43503), that allows unprivileged local users to gain full root access by manipulating cloned network packets through the XFRM/IPsec subsystem, all without leaving a trace in kernel logs or audit records.
